no_results_title: No results found for the current filters.
initial_prompt: Click on the map or search for a location to begin.
initial_dialog_desc: You can adjust the filters to find biomass sources. Click anywhere on the map to change your search center.
help_desc_p1: This tool is designed to help you locate and visualize different types of data on an interactive map. You can explore biomass power plants, agricultural crop areas, and forest species distributions across Spain.
help_desc_p2: Use the side panel to select a location, adjust the search radius, and toggle the different data layers. The results will be displayed on the map, and for biomass plants, also in a list. Click on any element on the map to get more details.
geolocation_not_supported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
geolocation_denied: Could not get your location. Please enable location services in your browser.
out_of_spain_desc: The selected location is outside of Spain. The available data is limited to Spanish territory.
lite_version_radius_limit: Lite version radius is limited to {maxRadius} km.
